fields.System.Title: INV-104 — Include batch detail in balance queries
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want balances broken down by batch, so that I can see
which batch is expiring and count a multi-batch location correctly.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a batch-tracked product, then every balance row carries its batch.
  • - Given a location holding two batches of one product, then the query returns two rows,
  • not a merged total.
  • - Given an untracked product, then the batch field is null and the response does not
  • invent one.
  • - Given a batch, then its expiry date and receipt date are included.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch |
| Risks | Merging batches hides the data counting and FEFO need ([doc 09 §6.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
